evals.name: explicit-request

evals.name: vague-session-mining
evals.prompt: The user runs /improve-skill with no skill named, saying only: 'that skill was annoying, make it better'. A condensed transcript of the session so far is at <FIXTURES>/session-transcript.md â€” read it to understand what happened. For this test environment, use these paths instead of any defaults: the skill dev folder (source of truth) is <FIXTURES>/dev-skills and the installed skills folder is <FIXTURES>/installed-skills. You cannot ask the user questions in this test; if the evidence makes the problem clear, state your assumption and proceed. The user pre-approves any proposal that addresses the problem evidenced in the transcript. Write a report.md to the outputs directory describing your diagnosis, the proposed change, and every action you took.
evals.expected_output: Identifies meeting-notes as the target from the transcript; diagnoses the missing Decisions section (a recurring complaint); adds decisions guidance to the skill in a generalized way; commits and reinstalls.
assertions: Report correctly identifies meeting-notes as the skill to improve, from the transcript alone
Diagnosis addresses the recurring missing-Decisions problem evidenced in the transcript
